einzeiler: Republican campaign rhetoric, Macklemore's tour controversy, and Can't Let It Go.
kurzfassung: Republican candidates use anti-Muslim rhetoric in their campaign ads and statements, raising questions about their motives. A free speech controversy unfolds after rapper Macklemore makes pro-Palestinian statements at concerts. The episode also features the regular segment Can't Let It Go.
stichpunkte: Inflammatory and anti-Muslim rhetoric in Republican campaign ads and statements
Motivations behind the political messaging of certain Republican candidates
Macklemore's removal from Ed Sheeran's shows following pro-Palestinian statements
The intersection of free speech and the music industry
The regular Friday segment Can't Let It Go
beschreibung:
Some Republican candidates are using inflammatory and anti-Muslim rhetoric in their campaign ads and public statements. We look at what they're saying, and why they're saying it.

Then, a free speech controversy made its way to the music world. After making pro-Palestinian statements during recent concerts, rapper Macklemore was removed from shows opening for Ed Sheeran. We explain what's going on.

And, as usual on Fridays: Can't Let It Go.

This episode: White House correspondent Danielle Kurtzleben, senior national political correspondent Tamara Keith, congressional correspondent Barbara Sprunt, and music reporter Isabella Gomez Sarmiento.

This podcast was produced and edited by Casey Morell and Bria Suggs.

Our executive producer is Muthoni Muturi.
